newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Cen.Bank sells 367.75 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia Cen.Bank sells 367.75 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 367.75 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills, OFZ interest-bearing government bonds and VSM railway bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Friday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 23006 issue closed on Friday at 80.19 percent, the 23007 issue closed at 79.34 percent, the 24011 issue closed at 100.67 percent, the 24012 issue closed at 99.65 percent, the 24013 issue closed at 96.82 percent and 22VSM03305 closed at 99.06 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
Full details of recent central bank transactions in the secondary market for the Finance Ministry can be seen on CBGKOSEC.
